args.message: I calculated revenue (the sum of order amounts) for each region and city, then each city's fraction of its region's revenue and of all revenue. The table has 12 region–city groups. Orders with no known region or city are kept as their own groups (shown as null). The null/null group includes orders whose customer is missing from the customers table. Paris is the only city with no known region, and it is treated as part of the null region.
